finding.claim: Long-line truncation computes subLineEnd with this.endColumn + padding without guarding undefined, producing NaN and an empty snippet when error has no range.
finding.title: showSourceCode NaN when endColumn undefined

verifier.reason: Confirmed: css-syntax-error.js:22-25 sets only line/column for numeric arguments leaving endColumn undefined, and css-syntax-error.js:82-86 computes Math.max(this.column+padding, this.endColumn+padding) unguarded, so undefined+padding yields NaN, Math.max yields NaN, and line.slice(subLineStart, NaN) yields an empty truncated line.

repro.testCode:
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import postcss from './postcss.js'

const input = 'a { color: red; }\n/*# sourceMappingURL=old.css.map */'
const result = postcss([]).process(input, { from: 'input.css', map: false })

assert.equal(result.css.includes('sourceMappingURL'), false)
assert.equal(result.css === input, false)
assert.equal(result.toString(), result.css)
assert.equal(String(result), result.css)
repro.expectedBehavior: NoWorkResult.toString()/String(result) returns the processed css (same as .css) after MapGenerator strips the stale sourceMappingURL annotation when map is disabled, matching Result#toString contract.
repro.rationale: With no plugins PostCSS returns NoWorkResult. Passing map:false forces the clearAnnotation branch, so result.css is stripped while _css remains raw; asserting toString equals css exposes the divergence.
repro.reason: test did not demonstrate the claim consistently
